# AASG

> AASG is a deterministic, code-first Android capture-to-publish tool. Android
> instrumentation tests own app navigation and state; AASG owns capture variants,
> collection, rendering, validation, and stable artifacts.

Use the Markdown pages below for implementation details. This index describes AASG
configuration schema 5 and the current published documentation.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://pedronveloso.github.io/AASG/overview.md.txt): Product boundary and safety model.
- [Quickstart](https://pedronveloso.github.io/AASG/getting-started/quickstart.md.txt): Install and run a first capture.
- [Android test contract](https://pedronveloso.github.io/AASG/concepts/android-test-contract.md.txt): Responsibilities and AndroidX Test Storage.
- [Capture workflow](https://pedronveloso.github.io/AASG/guides/capture-workflow.md.txt): Capture matrix, staging, manifests, and output safety.
- [Rendering pipelines](https://pedronveloso.github.io/AASG/guides/rendering.md.txt): Typed image and video operations.
- [Device frames and licensing](https://pedronveloso.github.io/AASG/guides/device-frames.md.txt): Frame sources and provenance.
- [aasg.yaml schema](https://pedronveloso.github.io/AASG/reference/configuration.md.txt): Complete configuration reference and canonical example.
- [CLI reference](https://pedronveloso.github.io/AASG/reference/cli.md.txt): Commands and options.
- [Semantic metadata](https://pedronveloso.github.io/AASG/reference/semantic-metadata.md.txt): Region and gesture schemas.
- [Contributing](https://pedronveloso.github.io/AASG/contributing.md.txt): Development and release practices.
